slices.title: Frame the game (camera, aspect, subject placement)
slices.feelIntent: The player can see what matters, at a readable scale, in a stable 16:9 frame.

slices.title: Build the core loop (the one verb this game is about)
slices.feelIntent: The primary action can be performed repeatedly and responds immediately to input.

slices.title: Surface state the player needs (HUD)
slices.feelIntent: Whatever the player must track to make decisions is legible on screen.

slices.title: Resolve the loop (win/lose, and a way back in)
slices.feelIntent: The run ends deliberately, the outcome is stated, and restarting is one action.
